title: Beauty to Business: An international hub for the cosmetics industry
summary: Beauty to Business Summit and Polo Innovation Day will return on October 21st and 22nd 2026 at the Bergamo Exhibition Centre, confirming their role as a key event for the Italian and international cosmetic manufacturing supply chain
